seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Carnegie, PA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Carnegie, PA for 2026: Santa party, Emmet Otter family show and a model railroad display, checked on the host's site.
lede: Carnegie keeps its holidays centered on the Andrew Carnegie Free Library and Music Hall, with a free Santa party, a family movie show with live music and a model railroad display.
celebrates: Carnegie's holiday season runs through the Andrew Carnegie Free Library and Music Hall on Beechwood Avenue. The library hosts its annual Carnegie Celebrates the Season party, sponsored with Carnegie Borough and the Carol Covi Children's Event Committee, with crafts, cookies, caricatures and free pictures with Santa. Its Carnegie Carnegie Family Performances series brings live music to young audiences, and the Carnegie Modular Railroaders set up a large model railroad layout each December. The Carnegie Performing Arts Center also stages The Nutcracker in the community in the middle of the month.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap for Carnegie, but the library's own pages give a clue. It says last year's Emmet Otter family show sold out, so the 2026 performance moved to the larger Music Hall. The library's Carnegie Celebrates the Season party is an annual event, and earlier editions are listed as passed on its calendar, so families who came before can expect a similar morning.
facts: The Andrew Carnegie Free Library and Music Hall is at 300 Beechwood Avenue in Carnegie. The library's Studio hosts the model railroad display, the Lincoln Gallery hosts a playtime for the littlest guests during the Santa party, and the Music Hall hosts screenings and family shows. The library says Emmet Otter's Jug-Band Christmas, a Jim Henson film, plays with live music by the Sweaty Already String Band, a bluegrass group.
trains: Carnegie has a December train attraction without a ticket: the Carnegie Modular Railroaders and the Mod Squad of northeast Ohio build an interconnected model railroad layout in the library's Studio, with buildings, tunnels, mountains and landscaping. For a real ride, the Pennsylvania Trolley Museum in Washington runs a Santa Trolley, and our Pittsburgh and Washington guides list the dates and prices checked on the host's site.
traditions: The library's annual holiday party with crafts, cookies, caricatures and free pictures with Santa.

Carnegie Performing Arts Center students and dancers from local studios perform the ballet in December.
kidfact: The Emmet Otter story is about a mother and son who each secretly enter a talent contest to buy the other a Christmas present.
faq: Mostly at the Andrew Carnegie Free Library and Music Hall, which runs an annual holiday party with Santa, a family show with live music and a model railroad display. Carnegie Borough sponsors the party with the library.
Is Santa free at the Carnegie library?

The library says pictures with Santa in front of the scenic fireplace are free at Carnegie Celebrates the Season, which is free to all and needs no registration. Guests must check in at the Music Hall lobby by 12:30 pm to get a photo and gift bag.
Where is the Carnegie model railroad display?

The display is in the Studio at the Andrew Carnegie Free Library and Music Hall, 300 Beechwood Avenue. It is built by the library's Carnegie Modular Railroaders and the Mod Squad of northeast Ohio, and it is free.
Why did the Emmet Otter show move to the Music Hall?
The library says last year's show sold out, so this year it moved to the Music Hall, which has more seats. It still expects a full house and suggests getting tickets early.
